why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate is flat at +0.00% and stayed flat across all 14 days, so there is no early lift that faded.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Latency p95 rose +6.00% and Abandonment Rate climbed +1.60%. Engagement suffered too, with CTR at -1.50%. A speed cost fits all three together.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: Worse results making users give up could also explain the abandonment and CTR moves. No cut has separated the two stories yet.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A pre-test comparison of Successful Search Rate showing the arms already differed before exposure would make the flat read unreliable.
Abandonment and CTR by latency bucket showing the harm sits only in slow queries would point to a fixable speed cost, worth a rerun with a faster v7.
A rerun with many more users that finds a lift of 0.50% or more would reopen the call.
